query.intent: The cookie URL filter (filterCookies) used for listing cookies prepends a dot to every cookie domain and compares paths by plain string prefix; it should follow RFC 6265 domain-match (host-only cookies match only exact host) and path-match (exact or slash boundary). Also the path check used when sending cookies (domainMatches/pathMatches in the cookie store) appends a slash to the request path, making /foo match /foo/.
query.symptom: Cookie listing for URLs returns host-only cookies for subdomains and path-prefix cookies like /api for /apiv2, and a cookie with path /foo/ is sent to /foo.
